children: Kolkata: AU Small Finance Bank reported a 53% surge in second-quarter net profit to 858 crore from 561 crore in the year-ago period, helped by business expansion and an improvement in asset quality.

The bank's net interest margin-a key profit metric-rose to 5.8% for the quarter from 5.5% in the year-ago period. AU's gross non-performing assets ratio fell 42 basis points (bps) to nearly 2% at the end of September. Provisions fell 25% to 359 crore from 481 crore. The net NPA ratio improved by 7 bps to 0.8%. Annualised credit cost fell by 45 bps to 0.8% from 1.2% a year earlier. One basis point is one-hundredth of a percentage point.

The bank, which is in the process of transforming itself into a universal lender, saw its pre-provision operating profit grow 28% year-on-year to 1,514 crore in the second quarter from 1,210 crore a year ago. Net interest income rose 32% to 2,820 crore from 2,144 crore a year earlier. Its gross loan portfolio grew 25% year-on-year to 1.5 lakh crore while total deposits expanded 29% to 1.7 lakh crore.

title: AU Small Finance Bank Net Profit Surges 53% in Q2
